2. Jungle Plank → Stick (2 jungle planks → 4 sticks)
3. Stick → Warped Stem (1 warped stem → 4 warped planks)
4. Stick → Crimson Stem (1 crimson stem → 4 crimson planks)

7. Stick → Shield (6 planks, 1 iron ingot → 1 shield)

9. Stick → Jungle Sign (6 jungle planks, 1 stick → 3 jungle signs)

This sequence ensures all necessary materials are gathered and used in the correct order to achieve the goal of crafting a jungle sign.
